hero.lede: One restless studio. Heavy music, developer tools, games, and deep research — shipped under one brand, directed by human hands, powered by modern tooling.
hero.thesis: AI is in the name. The wizard is in the work.

items.name: RepoForge Pro
items.description: One-command Python project bootstrapper: virtual env, curated dependencies by project type, git, GitHub remote, tests, and hooks. The "ml-experiment" profile scaffolds experiment and claims registries with falsification discipline.

items.name: The Mixin Field Manual
items.description: Cross-mod compatibility guide for Minecraft Forge & NeoForge: how mixins actually apply when 300 mods share a method — priorities, merges, and war stories from shipped Valkyrien Skies × Immersive Portals work.

lanes.name: Music
lanes.description: Heavy rock, metal, and country crossover under the WPAI name. Flagship thesis track: "Weaponized Mind." Distribution in motion.

lanes.name: Software
lanes.description: RepoForge, the Mixin Field Manual, HellForge (a studio terminal), and internal tooling. Distribution-first: finished work goes on sale.

lanes.name: Games & Research
lanes.description: Minecraft mod work (including an Astral Sorcery port) and long-horizon AI research. Audience and IP first, cash later.

about.section_label: The wizard is in the work
about.body: Wizard Productions AI Studio is what happens when one restless, weaponized mind stops asking permission. Founder Rob Bulkley (Mrwizard94) is AuADHD/ODD and treats it as an arsenal: intense interest in music, graphics, games, software, and deep AI research — and the modern tooling to run them as one studio. The AI collaboration is in the company name, disclosed on every release, and never apologized for. What can't be generated is the part WPAI actually sells: the ideas, the direction, the taste, the hours, and the hands-on finish on every track, tool, and graphic.
